shipyards at Ord Trasi and is offering to sell us information about their new building program.''"
"''I've dealt with my share of bounty hunters. What makes Colonel Derlin think we can trust him?''"
"''The smuggler offered what he said was a free sample: the information that there are three Imperial Star Destroyers within a month of completion out there.|[[Winter Celchu|Winter]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|''[[The Last Command]]''}} '''Ord Trasi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and a major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipbuilding]] world. ==Description== Conditions on the planet were favorable to a majority of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] citizens. Ord Trasi was a planet rich in natural resources: metals, [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. This allowed the planet to become a major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipbuilding]] world. [[Space station/Legends|Space platforms]] completely encircled the planet, defended in turn by a number of defense platforms. [[Mining/Legends|Mining]] and smelting was carried out by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] labor on the planet's two moons. Ord Trasi's resources also enabled the planet to be a manufacturer of weapons and communication gear. ==History== {{Quote|Look at all that new construction. They aren't kidding around, are they?''"
"''No, they're not. Nor are they kidding around at Ord Trasi or Yaga Minor.|[[Dankin]] and [[Talon Karrde]], about the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]|}} Ord Trasi was originally an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Prior to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']] was retired here.''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' The Galactic Republic was [[Attack on Ord Trasi|attacked]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on Ord Trasi during the [[Third Galactic War]].{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Odessen}} Established as a jump-off point and refueling depot for exploration missions, the Ord Trasi outpost saw heavy usage and gradually improved the level of its ship maintenance facilities, eventually becoming the major construction center. Ord Trasi itself was typical of most planets that serve as shipbuilding centers. Ord Trasi was the site of a [[Battle of Ord Trasi|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Ord Trasi was primarily responsible for the construction of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital combat starships]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. After the arrival of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], Ord Trasi's output was turned entirely to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] production. By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Diblen Harleys]] was investigating the information that at least three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] were under construction at the shipyards there. Eventually [[Imperial Skirmishes|captured]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Ord Trasi became the assembly point for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis's]] task force which would participate in the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Yaga Minor]]. The world was captured and occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they swept through the Outer Rim during the early stages of their invasion of the galaxy. Ord Trasi would later be liberated from the alien invaders by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and would remain under Imperial control. ==Behind the scenes== The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Ord Trasi in the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvan sector]] (a misspelling of the true [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian
